question: In Slack: React with the eyes emoji on the message in #incidents about the payment gateway timeout that was posted by someone who's a member of #payments-oncall. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
I checked — no match. The #payments-oncall channel has 3 members (U01AGENBOT9, UCSQXSCO8QP, U2VXWM7OP2O), and the payment gateway timeout messages in #incidents were posted by U2XQYVSHLFV, UMZ9EEV3P5R, UWXI0N2QO48, and UNB30QMY8TD — none of whom are on the #payments-oncall roster.

So there's no eyes reaction for me to add. The closest candidates, for reference:
- "FYI, seeing intermittent payment gateway timeout warnings in staging" (ts 1790259600.000005)
- "Another payment gateway timeout, this time hitting the refunds endpoint" (ts 1790259300.000004)
- "We're also seeing payment gateway timeout spikes in the EU region" (ts 1790259000.000003)
- "Getting the same payment gateway timeout error on the mobile checkout flow" (ts 1790258700.000002)

If you want, I can react to one of these anyway — just say which.
